evals.name: exec-status-update
evals.prompt: Make me a deck for tomorrow's VP Product 1:1. Status update on PHD migration. We're at 83% complete, blocker is MedMatch dep on visit_id assumption, planning to ship Milestone 4 by end of May, Milestone 5 blocked on Care EM capacity. 5-8 slides.
evals.expected_output: Native Google Slides deck. Slide 1 cover with deck title and subtitle 'For VP Product, [date]'. Slide 2 exec_summary with 3 cards (Migration health / Blocker / Capacity ask). Subsequent slides walk through milestones with at least one visual template. Final slide is a forward-looking ask. QA pass should be SHIP or SHIP_WITH_WARNINGS. Outline saved to outputs/.

assertions.description: Final output includes a docs.google.com/presentation URL
Outline includes at least 2 non-bullets template types
No em-dash characters in any slide text or speaker notes
An outputs/YYYY-MM-DD-*.json file exists for this deck
QA verdict is SHIP or SHIP_WITH_WARNINGS

evals.name: complex-strategic-deck
evals.prompt: Build slides explaining the TPA cutover plan. Two systems exist with the same TPA acronym (Titration Protocol Adjustment AND Treatment Plan Authority service). Audience is VP Eng plus SVP Eng. Need to cover: state machine (6 states, 11 transitions), dependencies on MedMatch and EMR layer, May 12 ClinOps cutover, June 1 provider-facing launch, 207k Strive WL re-Rx by July 17, rollback procedure undefined risk. 12-15 slides.
evals.expected_output: Medium-length deck with clear story arc. Cover, exec_summary, agenda (because >8 slides), section dividers between phases. moving_blueprint OR section_divider per spine rules. Visual templates for state machine and dependencies (flow_steps or three_card). Speaker notes on risk slide. VP Eng/SVP Eng audience tuning.

assertions.description: Final output includes a docs.google.com/presentation URL
Deck text disambiguates the two TPA meanings on first mention
Speaker notes or content reflect VP Eng/SVP Eng framing
More than half of content slides use non-bullets templates
QA verdict is SHIP or SHIP_WITH_WARNINGS

evals.name: short-tactical-deck
evals.prompt: Quick 5-slide deck for our team standup tomorrow about the WL Membership re-Rx flow. Background: 207k Strive customers need re-Rx by July 17. Today's status: blocked on MedMatch envelope size (7,323 byte limit hit). Need: temp workaround approved + perm fix scoped. Just my team, internal, fast.
evals.expected_output: Short deck (≤8 slides). Visual variety even at short length. No agenda (too short). Internal-team tone (informal). Final slide is action-oriented.

assertions.description: Final output includes a docs.google.com/presentation URL
QA verdict is SHIP or SHIP_WITH_WARNINGS
